=== v2:9c550043e len 5754

needsOtherGroup**
- **VIS-2 (js/render.js):** implement `render.warmup(): Promise<void>`; main.js and engine.js already call it when it exists. Pre-compiling only the scene from the boot camera, which is what my fallback does, leaves 30 programs that still link on the first title frame (1.5–2.8 s). The warm-up also needs to cover:
  - the composer's post-processing passes,
  - shadow-map depth materials,
  - objects that are hidden or have zero instances at boot (fx particles, decals, gate variants),
  - objects added at level start.

  One approach: compile with every object temporarily visible, then do one full draw to a tiny offscreen target, all inside a promise that waits on parallel shader compilation.
- **UI (js/ui.js), optional:** the debug panel cuts off long lines at the 390 px width (visible in the screenshots), and #overlay-msg is hidden a second time on resume. Both are cosmetic.
